variety_rules: Target variety: Levantine Arabic, Palestinian flavor. NOT Modern Standard Arabic. Always use the colloquial form; avoid MSA forms whenever a dialect form exists. Write in Arabic script with full diacritics, spelled consistently.

transliteration.latin_rules: Latin scheme: aa ii uu = long vowels; a i u short; H=ح kh=خ gh=غ '=ع and ء q=ق j=ج sh=ش th=ث dh=ذ; emphatics capitalised S=ص D=ض T=ط Z=ظ; w y; doubled letter = shadda. Write the dialect pronunciation (Palestinian), not the MSA one.
transliteration.hebrew_rules: Hebrew-letter scheme (Israeli convention, no nikud): ג'=ج ח'=خ ע'=غ ד'=ذ ת'=ث צ'=ض ט'=ظ; ח=ح ע=ع ט=ط צ=ص ק=ق א=ا/ء. Use א/ו/י for long vowels aa/uu/ii.

seed.instructions: Frequency-ordered everyday Levantine (Palestinian) vocabulary and short useful phrases. Prefer colloquial dialect forms over MSA (e.g. 'shu' not 'madha', 'halla'' not 'al-aan').
